--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -102,19 +102,42 @@
-            p0, p1 = pair
-            touched = []
-            # a merged pair never reappears, so its chunk set can be dropped
-            for k in where.pop(pair, ()):
-                old = ids[k]
-                new = merge(old, pair, idx)
-                if len(new) == len(old):
-                    continue
-                ids[k] = new
-                w = weights[k]
-                for p in zip(old, old[1:]):
-                    stats[p] -= w
-                    touched.append(p)
-                for p in zip(new, new[1:]):
-                    stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
-                    where[p].add(k)
-            for p in touched:
-                if stats_get(p) == 0:
-                    del stats[p]
+            p0, p1 = pair
+            touched = [pair]
+            rapp = touched.append
+            # a merged pair never reappears, so its chunk set can be dropped
+            for k in where.pop(pair, ()):
+                old = ids[k]
+                new = merge(old, pair, idx)
+                n_old = len(old)
+                m = n_old - len(new) # number of merged occurrences
+                if not m:
+                    continue
+                ids[k] = new
+                w = weights[k]
+                stats[pair] -= w * m
+                # only the pairs touching a merged occurrence change (idx does
+                # not occur in old, so new[q] == idx marks exactly the merges)
+                index = new.index
+                q = -1
+                for c in range(m):
+                    q = index(idx, q + 1)
+                    j = q + c # position of this occurrence in old
+                    if q:
+                        a = new[q-1]
+                        if a != idx:
+                            # (an adjacent previous occurrence already
+                            # accounted for the pair between them)
+                            p = (a, p0)
+                            stats[p] -= w
+                            rapp(p)
+                            p = (a, idx)
+                            stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
+                            where[p].add(k)
+                    if j + 2 < n_old:
+                        p = (p1, old[j+2])
+                        stats[p] -= w
+                        rapp(p)
+                        p = (idx, new[q+1])
+                        stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
+                        where[p].add(k)
+            for p in touched:
+                if stats_get(p) == 0:
+                    del stats[p]

actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train: after merging a pair in a chunk, update pair counts (and the where index) only around the merged occurrences, the same local scheme BasicTokenizer's _update_stats uses, generalized to chunk weights. Before, it subtracted every old pair, re-added every new pair and re-inserted the chunk into where[] for all of them. The final counts, where sets and zero-count deletions come out the same, so the merges are identical. train_ir drops about 4.7% (ratio 0.9531) and outputs are byte-identical.
